text: ちちゅうを　じそく　８０キロで　ほりながら　エサを　さがす。

structure.jp: ちちゅうを　じそく　８０キロで　ほりながら
structure.en: while digging through the ground at 80 km/h

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら after a verb says two things are done at the same time. ほりながら = 'while digging'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows how the action is done, in this case how fast. じそく ８０キロで = 'at 80 km an hour'.
